items.title: Why Colgate-Palmolive Remains an Overlooked Dividend King
items.summary: Colgate-Palmolive Company (NYSE:CL) is often overlooked when investors discuss established dividend stocks. Names such as Coca-Cola, Procter & Gamble, and Johnson & Johnson tend to dominate those conversations. Colgate has a track record that deserves to be mentioned alongside them. It is a Dividend King, with 63 consecutive years of dividend increases and uninterrupted dividend payments […]

items.title: 5 Dependable Dividend Stocks to Buy in August

items.title: How to Build $17,500 a Month in Dividend Income From Three Income Buckets
